title: THE PILLAR OF CLOUD AND FIRE

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text:
"After leaving Sukkoth they camped at Etham on the edge of the desert. By day
the LORD went ahead of them in a pillar of cloud to guide them on their way and
by night in a pillar of fire to give them light, so that they could travel by
day or night." - Ex 13:20-21 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God does not send a map. He goes ahead of them Himself.

Notice how the guidance fits the need. In the desert by day, the fierce enemy is
the sun, so God gives a cloud. At night the enemy is darkness, so God gives
fire. The same presence meets the opposite problem. What they needed in the heat
was shade; what they needed in the dark was light. God was both.

That is worth carrying with you. God does not offer one standard form of help.
He meets you according to the trouble you are actually in. In seasons of
exposure and pressure, He is covering. In seasons of confusion and darkness, He
is light.

Notice too that He went ahead. He was not driving them from behind or watching
from a distance. Jesus said of the good shepherd, "he goes on ahead of them, and
his sheep follow him because they know his voice" (John 10:4).

And this: they could travel by day or night. God's presence expanded what was
possible for them. Not because the desert got easier, but because He was there.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you need shade or light from God right now?
2. Are you following where God has already gone, or asking Him to follow your
   plans?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, go ahead of me. Be my shade when the heat is fierce and my light when the
way is dark. Amen.
